support_claim: Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, while the MSA-HELION-2019 header names Helion Robotics Ltd as counterparty and billing invoices use billed_name Helion Robotics Limited.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity rather than mere name compatibility. The packet links billing:Helion Robotics Limited to billed_name Helion Robotics Limited, links contract:MSA-HELION-2019 to counterparty Helion Robotics Ltd, and commercial_notes explicitly records that those two names denote the same legal entity, satisfying the positive disposition burden.
